title: Cobblemon PC Info
description: Add info about spawn locations, evolution requirements and breeding groups to the PC.
body:
Client-side Fabric add-on for Cobblemon that adds an info panel beside the PC UI.

The panel shows information when hovering Pokemon slots. It has tabs for:

- Evolution line, including requirement details such as level ranges, item predicates, move counts, and other requirement fields.
- Spawn pool entries, including rarity, context, weight, level range, and biome information when available.
- Breeding egg groups.
